title: Second part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero for the first part. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which includes a single loop containing a single circle. Position the center of the circle at coordinates [0.0907, 0.0907] and set the radius to 0.0907. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.1815. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.2419 units to create a three-dimensional solid body. The dimensions of the first part are 0.1814516129032258 units in length, 0.1814516129032258 units in width, and 0.24193548387096775 units in height.

For the second part, create another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of [0.0792, 0.0792, 0.2419]. On the first face, draw a single loop that contains a single circle. Place the center of the circle at [0.0115, 0.0115] and set the radius to 0.0115. Scale the sketch by a factor of 0.023. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the vector [0.0792, 0.0792, 0.2419]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.5081 units and add this extruded part to the existing solid body. The dimensions of the second part are 0.022983870967741935 units in length, 0.022983870967741935 units in width, and 0.5080645161290323 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create the base cylinder
base_cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0907, 0.0907)
    .circle(0.0907)
    .extrude(0.2419)
)

# Create the handle cylinder
handle_cylinder = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(0.0792 + 0.0115, 0.0792 + 0.0115)
    .circle(0.0115)
    .extrude(0.5081)
)

# Translate the handle to the correct position
handle_cylinder = handle_cylinder.translate((0, 0, 0.2419))

# Combine the base and handle
r = base_cylinder.union(handle_cylinder)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Cylinder base dimensions
base_dia = 0.1814
base_height = 0.241

# Rod dimensions
rod_dia = 0.020
total_height = 0.7500
rod_height = total_height - base_height

# Create the cylindrical base
base = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(base_dia / 2).extrude(base_height)

# Create the thin rod on top of the base
rod = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=base_height).circle(rod_dia / 2).extrude(rod_height)

# Combine into a single solid
r = base.union(rod)
